title: Verniman method: auction, order flow and execution knowledge base
summary: A source-backed method library covering 27 blog topics, plus local Daily Map calendar archives for 2017–2025 and January 1–October 30, 2026, with captured text/images and explicit source gaps, including the partial 2017 source trail.
data_summary: Method review: 27 pages, 46 videos, 42 caption exports. Daily Maps: 2026 has 201 maps/198 dates plus two undated commentaries; 2025 has 246/242; 2024 has 251/247; 2023 has 248/245; 2022 has 158/157, May 16–December 30, plus separate older context; 2021 has 250/246 plus one malformed-date article; 2020 has 251/248 with 502 image references across 502 unique files, including one qualified 400-pixel inline chart; 2019 has 248/246 with 496 image references across 495 unique files; 2018 has 249/245 with 496 image references across 496 unique files and one text-only source article. 2017 has 28/28, November 20–December 29, plus twelve undated daily plans and 80 plan images; five educational context records remain raw outside daily counts. All 3,590 scoped calendar dates recorded; no market-data calculations.
evidence_status: Qualitative source research and local source preservation. Annual snapshots retain gaps and duplicate dates. The 2022 early-year gap, source-year exceptions, malformed dates and image qualifications remain explicit. Near ATHs uses its independently reviewed 2021 date in that annual archive; completed earlier snapshots are unchanged. The 2018 December 24 article has no source images, and its publication/update claims do not replace anchored body dates. The 2017 trail has only 28 dated plans and twelve undated daily plans; navigation exhausts without a 2016 boundary, so historical completeness is not claimed. No trading validation.
